title: ForgeStream Real Apache Flink Benchmark Methodology

methodology.warmup_phase: 2,000 events pre-stream warmup to prime JVM JIT, PyFlink worker daemon, and socket pools
methodology.measurement_phase: 13,000 sustained steady-state events across 10 concurrent keyed assets
methodology.engine_under_test: Apache Flink 1.18.1 / PyFlink 1.18.1 DataStream API on Docker Linux
methodology.keyed_state_backend: Flink ValueState with checkpointing to file:///opt/forgestream/data/checkpoints
methodology.state_caching_strategy: Worker-local state cache with periodic/transition synchronization to ValueState
methodology.input_generation: Continuous multi-modal physical sensor streams (temp, vib, pres, curr, volt, pwr, spd)
